verdict.rationale: Vercel's deployment story centers on Git-based pushes and 40+ supported frameworks with zero-config builds; the only container-adjacent claim ('Run production workloads in isolated containers on Vercel') is vague marketing language likely describing internal runtime isolation, not a user-facing 'bring your own Dockerfile/Docker image' deployment path. Community evidence explicitly complains about restricted language support ('we only get JS/TS/Go, or WebAssembly gimmicks'), suggesting no general-purpose container deployment. No CLI/docs evidence shows a `vercel deploy --docker` or Dockerfile-based workflow.
